## Fishing Exposure Index : original approach 

```{r}
#| label: fishing-exposure-index
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

#======================
# FISHING EXPOSURE INDEX (FEI) CALCULATION
#======================

# --- 1. Prepare the base grid coordinates ---
# Using your existing raster template (already loaded as 'r')
coords <- as.data.frame(coordinates(r))
names(coords) <- c("Longitude", "Latitude")
coords$PUID <- 1:nrow(coords)

# --- 2. Prepare fishing effort data at 0.5° resolution ---
# aggregated_data already loaded from Predicted_Fishing_Hours_05Deg.Rdata
fishing_effort <- aggregated_data %>%
  rename(
    Longitude = lon_05deg,
    Latitude = lat_05deg,
    FishingHours = predicted_fishing_hours
  ) %>%
  mutate(FishingHours_Log = log1p(FishingHours))

# Join fishing effort to the base grid
coords_with_fishing <- coords %>%
  left_join(fishing_effort, by = c("Longitude", "Latitude")) %>%
  mutate(
    FishingHours = replace_na(FishingHours, 0),
    FishingHours_Log = replace_na(FishingHours_Log, 0),
    has_fishing_data = FishingHours > 0
  )

# --- 3. Load all species range rasters ---
tif_folder <- here::here("R", "Data", "tif files continental")
tif_files <- list.files(tif_folder, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

cat("Found", length(tif_files), "species range files\n")

# Function to extract species name from filename
extract_species_name <- function(filepath) {

  basename(filepath) %>%
    gsub("\\.tif$", "", .) %>%
    gsub("_", " ", .)
}

# Function to get presence cells for a species
get_species_presence <- function(tif_path) {
  sp_raster <- raster(tif_path)
  sp_values <- values(sp_raster)
  which(sp_values > 0 & !is.na(sp_values))
}

# Build species presence list
cat("Extracting species presence data...\n")

species_presence_list <- map(tif_files, function(f) {
  tryCatch({
    get_species_presence(f)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error reading:", f))
    return(integer(0))
  })
}, .progress = TRUE)

names(species_presence_list) <- sapply(tif_files, extract_species_name)

# --- 4. Calculate FEI for each species ---
cat("Calculating Fishing Exposure Index for each species...\n")

FEI_results <- map_dfr(names(species_presence_list), function(sp_name) {
  
  presence_cells <- species_presence_list[[sp_name]]
  
  if (length(presence_cells) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      Species = sp_name,
      Range_Size = 0,
      Cells_With_Fishing_Data = NA,
      Fishing_Data_Coverage = NA,
      FEI_raw = NA,
      FEI_log = NA,
      Total_Fishing_Hours = NA
    ))
  }
  
  sp_fishing <- coords_with_fishing %>%
    filter(PUID %in% presence_cells)
  
  tibble(
    Species = sp_name,
    Range_Size = length(presence_cells),
    Cells_With_Fishing_Data = sum(sp_fishing$has_fishing_data),
    Fishing_Data_Coverage = sum(sp_fishing$has_fishing_data) / length(presence_cells),
    FEI_raw = mean(sp_fishing$FishingHours, na.rm = TRUE),
    FEI_log = mean(sp_fishing$FishingHours_Log, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Fishing_Hours = sum(sp_fishing$FishingHours, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}, .progress = TRUE)

# --- 5. Merge with species conservation metrics ---
FEI_results <- FEI_results %>%
  left_join(
    shark_metrics %>% 
      rename(Species = `Species name`) %>%
      mutate(Species = gsub("_", " ", Species)) %>%
      dplyr::select(Species, IUCN, FUSE, EDGE2),
    by = "Species"
  )

# --- 6. Summary statistics ---
cat("\n=== FEI SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total species processed:", nrow(FEI_results), "\n")
cat("Species with fishing data coverage >50%:", 
    sum(FEI_results$Fishing_Data_Coverage > 0.5, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Species with fishing data coverage <10%:", 
    sum(FEI_results$Fishing_Data_Coverage < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\nFEI (log-transformed) distribution:\n")
print(summary(FEI_results$FEI_log))

# --- 7. Top exposed species table ---
FEI_top20 <- FEI_results %>%
  filter(Fishing_Data_Coverage >= 0.5) %>%
  arrange(desc(FEI_log)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, IUCN, FUSE, EDGE2, FEI_log, Range_Size, Fishing_Data_Coverage) %>%
  head(20)

# Save the FEI top 20 species table
fei_top20_table <- kable(FEI_top20,
      format = "html",
      digits = 2,
      col.names = c("Species", "IUCN", "FUSE", "EDGE2", "FEI (log)", 
                    "Range Size", "Fishing Coverage"),
      caption = "Top 20 species by Fishing Exposure Index (FEI)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)

save_kable(fei_top20_table, 
           file = here::here("R", "Outputs", "Table_top20_FEI_species.png"),
           zoom = 2)

cat("FEI top 20 species table saved.\n")

# --- 8. Save FEI results ---
saveRDS(FEI_results, here::here("R", "Data", "Species_FEI_results.rds"))
write_csv(FEI_results, here::here("R", "Outputs", "Species_FEI_results.csv"))

cat("\nFEI results saved.\n")
```

## Standardised Fishing Exposure Index

```{r}
#| label: standardized-fishing-exposure-index
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

#======================
# STANDARDIZED FISHING EXPOSURE INDEX (SFEI)
# Null model: shuffle fishing effort within FAO zones
#======================

library(furrr)
library(future)

# --- 1. Load FAO Major Fishing Areas ---
fao_zones <- st_read(here::here("R", "Data", "FAO_Major_Fishing_Areas.geojson"))

# Repair geometries and disable S2
fao_zones <- fao_zones %>% st_make_valid()
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

cat("Number of FAO zones:", nrow(fao_zones), "\n")

# --- 2. Assign each grid cell to FAO zones (rasterization method) ---
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
fao_zones <- fao_zones %>% st_make_valid()

# Create a numeric ID for each FAO zone
fao_zones$FAO_ID <- as.numeric(as.factor(fao_zones$F_AREA))
fao_lookup <- fao_zones %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  dplyr::select(FAO_ID, FAO_AREA = F_AREA) %>%
  distinct()

# Rasterize FAO zones to match species raster grid
cat("Rasterizing FAO zones...\n")
fao_raster <- rasterize(fao_zones, r, field = "FAO_ID")

# Extract FAO zone for each cell
fao_values <- values(fao_raster)

# Add to coords
coords_with_fao <- coords_with_fishing %>%
  mutate(FAO_ID = fao_values) %>%
  left_join(fao_lookup, by = "FAO_ID")

# --- Fix duplicate columns if they exist ---
if ("FishingHours_Log.x" %in% names(coords_with_fao)) {
  coords_with_fao <- coords_with_fao %>%
    rename(
      FishingHours = FishingHours.x,
      FishingHours_Log = FishingHours_Log.x,
      has_fishing_data = has_fishing_data.x
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-ends_with(".y"))
}

sf_use_s2(TRUE)

cat("Cells assigned to FAO zones:", sum(!is.na(coords_with_fao$FAO_AREA)), 
    "out of", nrow(coords_with_fao), "\n")

# Verify fishing data is present
fishing_log_vector <- coords_with_fao$FishingHours_Log
cat("fishing_log_vector length:", length(fishing_log_vector), "\n")
cat("fishing_log_vector range:", min(fishing_log_vector, na.rm = TRUE), "-", 
    max(fishing_log_vector, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("Cells assigned to FAO zones:", sum(!is.na(coords_with_fao$FAO_AREA)), 
    "out of", nrow(coords_with_fao), "\n")

fishing_log_vector <- coords_with_fao$FishingHours_Log

# --- 3. Precompute FAO zone cell indices for efficient shuffling ---
fao_cell_indices <- coords_with_fao %>%
  filter(!is.na(FAO_AREA)) %>%
  group_by(FAO_AREA) %>%
  summarise(
    cell_indices = list(which(coords_with_fao$FAO_AREA == first(FAO_AREA))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create a lookup vector: for each cell, which FAO zone?
cell_fao_lookup <- coords_with_fao$FAO_AREA

# --- 4. Function to generate one shuffled fishing effort vector ---
shuffle_fishing_within_fao <- function(fishing_vector, fao_vector) {
  shuffled <- fishing_vector
  unique_faos <- unique(fao_vector[!is.na(fao_vector)])
  
  for (fao in unique_faos) {
    fao_indices <- which(fao_vector == fao)
    shuffled[fao_indices] <- sample(fishing_vector[fao_indices])
  }
  
  return(shuffled)
}

# --- 5. Function to calculate FEI for a species given a fishing vector ---
calculate_FEI <- function(presence_cells, fishing_vector) {
  mean(fishing_vector[presence_cells], na.rm = TRUE)
}

# --- 6. Calculate SFEI for all species ---
cat("Calculating Standardized Fishing Exposure Index (SFEI)...\n")
cat("Running 99 null iterations (shuffling fishing within FAO zones)...\n")

n_iterations <- 99

# Pre-generate all shuffled fishing vectors (more efficient)
cat("Pre-generating shuffled fishing effort vectors...\n")
fishing_log_vector <- coords_with_fao$FishingHours_Log

shuffled_fishing_list <- replicate(
  n_iterations,
  shuffle_fishing_within_fao(fishing_log_vector, cell_fao_lookup),
  simplify = FALSE
)

# Parallel processing setup
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)

SFEI_results <- future_map_dfr(names(species_presence_list), function(sp_name) {
  
  presence_cells <- species_presence_list[[sp_name]]
  
  if (length(presence_cells) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      Species = sp_name,
      FEI_observed = NA,
      FEI_null_mean = NA,
      FEI_null_sd = NA,
      SFEI = NA,
      p_value = NA,
      Exposure_Category = NA
    ))
  }
  
  # Observed FEI (using log-transformed fishing hours)
  FEI_obs <- calculate_FEI(presence_cells, fishing_log_vector)
  
  # Null distribution: FEI under shuffled fishing effort
  null_FEIs <- sapply(shuffled_fishing_list, function(shuffled_fishing) {
    calculate_FEI(presence_cells, shuffled_fishing)
  })
  
  null_mean <- mean(null_FEIs, na.rm = TRUE)
  null_sd <- sd(null_FEIs, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Calculate SFEI (Z-score)
  if (is.na(null_sd) || null_sd == 0) {
    SFEI <- NA
    p_value <- NA
  } else {
    SFEI <- (FEI_obs - null_mean) / null_sd
    
    # Two-tailed p-value
    n_valid <- sum(!is.na(null_FEIs))
    if (FEI_obs > null_mean) {
      p_value <- (sum(null_FEIs >= FEI_obs, na.rm = TRUE) + 1) / (n_valid + 1)
    } else {
      p_value <- (sum(null_FEIs <= FEI_obs, na.rm = TRUE) + 1) / (n_valid + 1)
    }
  }
  
  # Categorize exposure (following GPT's suggestion)
  exposure_cat <- case_when(
    is.na(SFEI) ~ "Insufficient data",
    SFEI > 1.96 ~ "Highly overexposed",
    SFEI > 0 ~ "Moderately overexposed",
    SFEI <= 0 ~ "Underexposed"
  )
  
  tibble(
    Species = sp_name,
    FEI_observed = FEI_obs,
    FEI_null_mean = null_mean,
    FEI_null_sd = null_sd,
    SFEI = SFEI,
    p_value = p_value,
    Exposure_Category = exposure_cat
  )
  
}, .progress = TRUE, .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE))

plan(sequential)

# --- 7. Merge with FEI results and conservation metrics ---
# Remove any existing conservation columns to avoid duplicate joins
SFEI_results <- SFEI_results %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, FEI_observed, FEI_null_mean, FEI_null_sd, SFEI, p_value, Exposure_Category) %>%
  left_join(
    FEI_results %>% dplyr::select(Species, Range_Size, Fishing_Data_Coverage, IUCN, FUSE, EDGE2),
    by = "Species"
  )
# --- 8. Summary statistics ---
cat("\n=== SFEI SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")

exposure_summary <- SFEI_results %>%
  count(Exposure_Category) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

kable(exposure_summary,
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Exposure Category", "N Species", "Percentage"),
      caption = "Distribution of species by fishing exposure category") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)

cat("\nSFEI distribution:\n")
print(summary(SFEI_results$SFEI))

# --- 9. Top highly overexposed species ---

SFEI_highly_overexposed <- SFEI_results %>%
  filter(Exposure_Category == "Highly overexposed") %>%
  arrange(desc(SFEI)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, IUCN, FUSE, EDGE2, SFEI, FEI_observed, p_value) %>%
  head(20)

# Save the SFEI highly overexposed species table
sfei_overexposed_table <- kable(SFEI_highly_overexposed,
      format = "html",
      digits = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 2, 4),
      col.names = c("Species", "IUCN", "FUSE", "EDGE2", "SFEI", "FEI obs", "p-value"),
      caption = "Top 20 highly overexposed species (SFEI > 1.96)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)

save_kable(sfei_overexposed_table, 
           file = here::here("R", "Outputs", "Table_top20_SFEI_overexposed_species.png"),
           zoom = 2)

cat("SFEI overexposed species table saved.\n")

# --- 10. High-conflict species (threatened + highly overexposed) ---
conflict_species <- SFEI_results %>%
  filter(
    Exposure_Category == "Highly overexposed",
    IUCN >= 3  # VU, EN, or CR
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(SFEI))

cat("\n=== HIGH-CONFLICT SPECIES ===\n")
cat("Threatened species (VU, EN, CR) that are highly overexposed:", 
    nrow(conflict_species), "\n\n")

conflict_table <- kable(conflict_species %>% 
        dplyr::select(Species, IUCN, FUSE, EDGE2, SFEI, FEI_observed) %>%
        head(20),
      format = "html",
      digits = 2,
      col.names = c("Species", "IUCN", "FUSE", "EDGE2", "SFEI", "FEI obs"),
      caption = "High-conflict species: threatened and highly overexposed to fishing") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)

# Save as PNG
save_kable(conflict_table, 
           file = here::here("R", "Outputs", "Table_high_conflict_species.png"),
           zoom = 2)  # zoom increases resolution

# --- 11. Save SFEI results ---
saveRDS(SFEI_results, here::here("R", "Data", "Species_SFEI_results.rds"))
write_csv(SFEI_results, here::here("R", "Outputs", "Species_SFEI_results.csv"))

cat("\nSFEI results saved.\n")
```


## Maps of FEI and SFEI
```{r}
#| label: fei-sfei-maps
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 12

#======================
# SPATIAL MAPS OF FEI AND SFEI
#======================

# --- 1. Calculate cell-level metrics ---
cat("Calculating cell-level FEI and SFEI metrics...\n")

# Get species list for each category
highly_overexposed_species <- SFEI_results %>%
  filter(Exposure_Category == "Highly overexposed") %>%
  pull(Species)

high_conflict_species <- SFEI_results %>%
  filter(Exposure_Category == "Highly overexposed", IUCN >= 3) %>%
  pull(Species)

cat("Highly overexposed species:", length(highly_overexposed_species), "\n")
cat("High-conflict species:", length(high_conflict_species), "\n")

# Create a data frame to store cell-level metrics
cell_metrics <- data.frame(
  PUID = 1:length(values(r)),
  mean_FEI = NA_real_,
  mean_SFEI = NA_real_,
  richness_highly_overexposed = 0,
  richness_high_conflict = 0
)

# For efficiency, create a matrix of species presence (species x cells)
cat("Building species presence matrix...\n")

# Get FEI and SFEI values as named vectors for fast lookup
fei_values <- setNames(SFEI_results$FEI_observed, SFEI_results$Species)
sfei_values <- setNames(SFEI_results$SFEI, SFEI_results$Species)

# Initialize vectors for accumulating sums
n_species_per_cell <- rep(0, nrow(cell_metrics))
sum_fei_per_cell <- rep(0, nrow(cell_metrics))
sum_sfei_per_cell <- rep(0, nrow(cell_metrics))
richness_overexposed <- rep(0, nrow(cell_metrics))
richness_conflict <- rep(0, nrow(cell_metrics))

# Loop through species and accumulate metrics
cat("Calculating metrics per cell (this may take a few minutes)...\n")

for (sp_name in names(species_presence_list)) {
  presence_cells <- species_presence_list[[sp_name]]
  
  if (length(presence_cells) == 0) next
  
  # Get FEI and SFEI for this species
  sp_fei <- fei_values[sp_name]
  sp_sfei <- sfei_values[sp_name]
  
  if (is.na(sp_fei) || is.na(sp_sfei)) next
  
  # Accumulate for mean calculations
  n_species_per_cell[presence_cells] <- n_species_per_cell[presence_cells] + 1
  sum_fei_per_cell[presence_cells] <- sum_fei_per_cell[presence_cells] + sp_fei
  sum_sfei_per_cell[presence_cells] <- sum_sfei_per_cell[presence_cells] + sp_sfei
  
  # Count richness for subsets
  if (sp_name %in% highly_overexposed_species) {
    richness_overexposed[presence_cells] <- richness_overexposed[presence_cells] + 1
  }
  if (sp_name %in% high_conflict_species) {
    richness_conflict[presence_cells] <- richness_conflict[presence_cells] + 1
  }
}

# Calculate means
cell_metrics$mean_FEI <- ifelse(n_species_per_cell > 0, 
                                 sum_fei_per_cell / n_species_per_cell, 
                                 NA)
cell_metrics$mean_SFEI <- ifelse(n_species_per_cell > 0, 
                                  sum_sfei_per_cell / n_species_per_cell, 
                                  NA)
cell_metrics$richness_highly_overexposed <- richness_overexposed
cell_metrics$richness_high_conflict <- richness_conflict
cell_metrics$species_richness <- n_species_per_cell

# Add coordinates
cell_metrics <- cell_metrics %>%
  left_join(coords, by = "PUID")

cat("Cell metrics calculated.\n")
cat("Cells with species data:", sum(n_species_per_cell > 0), "\n")

# --- 2. Prepare spatial data ---
# Define projection
mcbryde_thomas_2 <- "+proj=mbt_s"

# Filter to cells with data and convert to sf
cell_metrics_sf <- cell_metrics %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_FEI)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

# World map and globe border (reuse from earlier if available, or recreate)
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
world_projected <- st_transform(world, crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

globe_bbox <- rbind(c(-180, -90), c(-180, 90),
                    c(180, 90), c(180, -90), c(-180, -90))
globe_border <- st_polygon(list(globe_bbox)) %>%
  st_sfc(crs = 4326) %>%
  st_sf(data.frame(rgn = 'globe', geom = .)) %>%
  smoothr::densify(max_distance = 0.5) %>%
  st_transform(crs = mcbryde_thomas_2)

# Base theme (matching bivariate maps)
map_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(margin = margin(b = 10)),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0)
  )

# --- 3. Create the four maps ---

# Map 1: Mean FEI per cell
map_mean_fei <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = cell_metrics_sf, aes(color = mean_FEI), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_sf(data = world_projected, fill = "lightgrey", color = "lightgrey", size = 0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = globe_border, fill = NA, color = "lightgrey", size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "inferno",
    name = "Mean FEI",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 20, barheight = 0.5,
                           title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(title = "(A) Mean Fishing Exposure Index (FEI)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  map_theme

# Map 2: Mean SFEI per cell
map_mean_sfei <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = cell_metrics_sf, aes(color = mean_SFEI), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_sf(data = world_projected, fill = "lightgrey", color = "lightgrey", size = 0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = globe_border, fill = NA, color = "lightgrey", size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    name = "Mean SFEI",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 20, barheight = 0.5,
                           title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(title = "(B) Mean Standardized Fishing Exposure Index (SFEI)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  map_theme

# Map 3: Richness of highly overexposed species
# Filter to cells with at least one highly overexposed species
cell_overexposed_sf <- cell_metrics_sf %>%
  filter(richness_highly_overexposed > 0)

map_richness_overexposed <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = cell_overexposed_sf, aes(color = richness_highly_overexposed), 
          size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_sf(data = world_projected, fill = "lightgrey", color = "lightgrey", size = 0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = globe_border, fill = NA, color = "lightgrey", size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "rocket",
    direction = -1,
    name = "Species richness",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 20, barheight = 0.5,
                           title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(title = "(C) Richness of highly overexposed species (SFEI > 1.96)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  map_theme

# Map 4: Richness of high-conflict species
# Filter to cells with at least one high-conflict species
cell_conflict_sf <- cell_metrics_sf %>%
  filter(richness_high_conflict > 0)

map_richness_conflict <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = cell_conflict_sf, aes(color = richness_high_conflict), 
          size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_sf(data = world_projected, fill = "lightgrey", color = "lightgrey", size = 0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = globe_border, fill = NA, color = "lightgrey", size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = c("#FEE5D9", "#FCAE91", "#FB6A4A", "#DE2D26", "#A50F15"),
    name = "Species richness",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 20, barheight = 0.5,
                           title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(title = "(D) Richness of high-conflict species (SFEI > 1.96 & IUCN ≥ VU)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  map_theme

# --- 4. Combine into 2x2 grid ---
combined_maps <- (map_mean_fei | map_mean_sfei) / 
                 (map_richness_overexposed | map_richness_conflict)

ggsave(
  here::here("R", "Outputs", "Fig_FEI_SFEI_maps_combined.png"),
  combined_maps,
  width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

# --- 5. Also save individual maps ---
ggsave(here::here("R", "Outputs", "Map_mean_FEI.png"),
       map_mean_fei, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

ggsave(here::here("R", "Outputs", "Map_mean_SFEI.png"),
       map_mean_sfei, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

ggsave(here::here("R", "Outputs", "Map_richness_highly_overexposed.png"),
       map_richness_overexposed, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

ggsave(here::here("R", "Outputs", "Map_richness_high_conflict.png"),
       map_richness_conflict, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

cat("\nAll maps saved.\n")

# --- 6. Summary statistics for maps ---
cat("\n=== SPATIAL SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n\n")

cat("Mean FEI across cells:\n")
print(summary(cell_metrics$mean_FEI))

cat("\nMean SFEI across cells:\n")
print(summary(cell_metrics$mean_SFEI))

cat("\nHighly overexposed species richness per cell:\n")
print(summary(cell_metrics$richness_highly_overexposed[cell_metrics$richness_highly_overexposed > 0]))

cat("\nHigh-conflict species richness per cell:\n")
print(summary(cell_metrics$richness_high_conflict[cell_metrics$richness_high_conflict > 0]))

cat("\nCells with at least one highly overexposed species:", 
    sum(cell_metrics$richness_highly_overexposed > 0), "\n")
cat("Cells with at least one high-conflict species:", 
    sum(cell_metrics$richness_high_conflict > 0), "\n")

# --- 7. Save cell metrics for further analysis ---
saveRDS(cell_metrics, here::here("R", "Data", "Cell_FEI_SFEI_metrics.rds"))
write_csv(cell_metrics, here::here("R", "Outputs", "Cell_FEI_SFEI_metrics.csv"))

cat("\nCell-level metrics saved.\n")
```

## Comparison FEI: Mean vs Tercile Approach 

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Comparison FEI: Mean vs Tercile Approach (Albouy et al. 2020)
# =============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Calculate global terciles of log(fishing hours)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Extract all fishing values per cell (log-transformed)
all_fishing_values <- aggregated_data %>%
  filter(predicted_fishing_hours > 0) %>%
  mutate(log_fishing = log(predicted_fishing_hours + 1))

# Global terciles
terciles <- quantile(all_fishing_values$log_fishing, probs = c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Global terciles of log(fishing hours):\n")
cat("T1 (Low/Medium boundary):", terciles[1], "\n")
cat("T2 (Medium/High boundary):", terciles[2], "\n")

# Categorize each cell
all_fishing_values <- all_fishing_values %>%
  mutate(
    fishing_category = case_when(
      log_fishing <= terciles[1] ~ "Low",
      log_fishing <= terciles[2] ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ "High"
    ),
    fishing_score = case_when(
      log_fishing <= terciles[1] ~ 0,
      log_fishing <= terciles[2] ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 2
    )
  )

# Check distribution
table(all_fishing_values$fishing_category)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Calculate FEI "terciles" for each species
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Create lookup cell -> fishing category
cell_fishing_category <- cell_metrics %>%
  dplyr::select(PUID, Longitude, Latitude) %>%
  left_join(
    all_fishing_values %>% 
      dplyr::select(lon_05deg, lat_05deg, log_fishing, fishing_score),
    by = c("Longitude" = "lon_05deg", "Latitude" = "lat_05deg")
  )

# Calculate FEI_terciles for each species
FEI_terciles <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(species_presence_list), function(sp) {
    cells <- species_presence_list[[sp]]
    
    # Get fishing scores for these cells
    sp_fishing <- cell_fishing_category %>%
      filter(PUID %in% cells) %>%
      filter(!is.na(fishing_score))
    
    if(nrow(sp_fishing) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    # Calculate proportions in each category
    n_total <- nrow(sp_fishing)
    a <- sum(sp_fishing$fishing_score == 0) / n_total  # proportion Low
    b <- sum(sp_fishing$fishing_score == 1) / n_total  # proportion Medium
    c <- sum(sp_fishing$fishing_score == 2) / n_total  # proportion High
    
    # FEI following Albouy et al.
    FEI_terc <- a * 0 + b * 1 + c * 2
    
    data.frame(
      Species = sp,
      prop_Low = a,
      prop_Medium = b,
      prop_High = c,
      FEI_terciles = FEI_terc,
      n_cells = n_total
    )
  })
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Compare with original FEI (mean)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

comparison <- FEI_terciles %>%
  left_join(
    FEI_results %>% dplyr::select(Species, FEI_log, Range_Size),
    by = "Species"
  ) %>%
  rename(FEI_mean = FEI_log)

# Correlation
cor_test <- cor.test(comparison$FEI_mean, comparison$FEI_terciles, method = "spearman")
cat("\n=== Correlation between both approaches ===\n")
cat("Spearman rho:", cor_test$estimate, "\n")
cat("p-value:", cor_test$p.value, "\n")

# Summaries
cat("\n=== Summary FEI mean (original approach) ===\n")
print(summary(comparison$FEI_mean))

cat("\n=== Summary FEI terciles (Albouy approach) ===\n")
print(summary(comparison$FEI_terciles))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Visualization
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Scatter plot comparison
p_comparison <- ggplot(comparison, aes(x = FEI_mean, y = FEI_terciles)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "FEI (mean log fishing hours)",
    y = "FEI (tercile proportions, Albouy et al.)",
    title = "Comparison of FEI calculation approaches",
    subtitle = paste0("Spearman ρ = ", round(cor_test$estimate, 3))
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p_comparison)

# Does ranking change?
comparison <- comparison %>%
  mutate(
    rank_mean = rank(-FEI_mean),
    rank_terciles = rank(-FEI_terciles),
    rank_diff = abs(rank_mean - rank_terciles)
  )

cat("\n=== Ranking changes ===\n")
cat("Rank correlation:", cor(comparison$rank_mean, comparison$rank_terciles, method = "spearman"), "\n")
cat("Mean rank difference:", mean(comparison$rank_diff), "\n")
cat("Max rank difference:", max(comparison$rank_diff), "\n")

# Top 10 with each method
cat("\n=== Top 10 FEI mean ===\n")
print(comparison %>% arrange(desc(FEI_mean)) %>% dplyr::select(Species, FEI_mean, FEI_terciles) %>% head(10))

cat("\n=== Top 10 FEI terciles ===\n")
print(comparison %>% arrange(desc(FEI_terciles)) %>% dplyr::select(Species, FEI_mean, FEI_terciles) %>% head(10))

# =============================================================================
# Map Mean FEI (tercile approach) per grid cell
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Calculate mean FEI_terciles per cell
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# First, join species FEI_terciles to presence data
cell_FEI_terciles <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(species_presence_list), function(sp) {
    cells <- species_presence_list[[sp]]
    fei_terc <- FEI_terciles %>% filter(Species == sp) %>% pull(FEI_terciles)
    
    if(length(fei_terc) == 0 || is.na(fei_terc)) return(NULL)
    
    data.frame(
      PUID = cells,
      Species = sp,
      FEI_terciles = fei_terc
    )
  })
) %>%
  # Join coordinates
  left_join(
    cell_metrics %>% dplyr::select(PUID, Longitude, Latitude),
    by = "PUID"
  ) %>%
  # Calculate mean per cell
  group_by(PUID, Longitude, Latitude) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_FEI_terciles = mean(FEI_terciles, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_species = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("=== Summary of mean FEI (terciles) per cell ===\n")
print(summary(cell_FEI_terciles$mean_FEI_terciles))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Compare with mean FEI (original approach) per cell
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Join both approaches
cell_comparison <- cell_FEI_terciles %>%
  left_join(
    cell_metrics %>% dplyr::select(PUID, mean_FEI),
    by = "PUID"
  )

# Correlation at cell level
cor_cell <- cor.test(cell_comparison$mean_FEI, cell_comparison$mean_FEI_terciles, 
                     method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
cat("\n=== Cell-level correlation between approaches ===\n")
cat("Spearman rho:", cor_cell$estimate, "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create maps
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

library(patchwork)

# Map FEI mean (original)
p_map_fei_mean <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = cell_comparison, 
            aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = mean_FEI)) +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey40", color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", name = "Mean FEI") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "(A) Mean FEI - Original approach (mean log fishing hours)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
  )

# Map FEI terciles (Albouy approach)
p_map_fei_terciles <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = cell_comparison, 
            aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = mean_FEI_terciles)) +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey40", color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", name = "Mean FEI", limits = c(0, 2)) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "(B) Mean FEI - Tercile approach (Albouy et al. 2020)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
  )

# Combine maps
p_fei_comparison <- p_map_fei_mean / p_map_fei_terciles

print(p_fei_comparison)

ggsave(here("R", "Outputs", "Fig_FEI_comparison_mean_vs_terciles.png"), 
       p_fei_comparison, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Scatter plot of cell-level comparison
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

p_cell_scatter <- ggplot(cell_comparison, aes(x = mean_FEI, y = mean_FEI_terciles)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean FEI (original: mean log fishing hours)",
    y = "Mean FEI (tercile approach)",
    title = "Cell-level comparison of FEI approaches",
    subtitle = paste0("Spearman ρ = ", round(cor_cell$estimate, 3))
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p_cell_scatter)

ggsave(here("R", "Outputs", "Fig_FEI_cell_comparison_scatter.png"), 
       p_cell_scatter, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## Ecoregion breakdown of FEI and SFEI

```{r}
#| label: fei-sfei-ecoregion-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

#======================
# FEI AND SFEI BREAKDOWN BY ECOREGION
#======================

# --- 0. Filter to continental waters only ---
cat("Filtering to continental waters...\n")

# Create high seas template raster using terra
template_raster <- rast(ext(High_seas), resolution = 0.5)
highseas_raster <- rasterize(vect(High_seas), template_raster, field = 1, background = 0)

# Convert cell_metrics to terra SpatVector for extraction
cell_points <- vect(as.data.frame(cell_metrics),
                    geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
                    crs = crs(highseas_raster))

# Extract values from highseas raster
highseas_values <- terra::extract(highseas_raster, cell_points)

# Add highseas classification back to the dataframe
cell_metrics$is_highseas <- highseas_values[, 2]
cell_metrics$is_highseas[is.na(cell_metrics$is_highseas)] <- 0

# Filter to keep only continental waters
cell_metrics_continental <- cell_metrics %>%
  filter(is_highseas == 0, !is.na(mean_FEI))

cat("Continental cells:", nrow(cell_metrics_continental), 
    "out of", nrow(cell_metrics), "\n")

# --- 1. Intersect with ecoregions (not join) ---
cat("Intersecting with ecoregions...\n")

grid_sf <- cell_metrics_continental %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)

meow_ecos <- st_transform(meow_ecos, st_crs(grid_sf))
meow_ecos <- st_make_valid(meow_ecos)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# st_intersection keeps only cells INSIDE ecoregion polygons
grid_ecoregions <- st_intersection(grid_sf, meow_ecos)

sf_use_s2(TRUE)
cat("Cells within ecoregions:", nrow(grid_ecoregions), "\n")

# --- 2. Calculate ecoregion-level statistics ---
ecoregion_stats <- grid_ecoregions %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(ECOREGION)) %>%
  group_by(ECOREGION) %>%
  summarise(
    PROVINCE = first(PROVINCE),
    REALM = first(REALM),
    mean_FEI = mean(mean_FEI, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_FEI = sd(mean_FEI, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_SFEI = mean(mean_SFEI, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_SFEI = sd(mean_SFEI, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_richness_overexposed = mean(richness_highly_overexposed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_richness_overexposed = sd(richness_highly_overexposed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_richness_conflict = mean(richness_high_conflict, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_richness_conflict = sd(richness_high_conflict, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_cells = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 3. Join stats back to simplified ecoregion polygons ---
meow_ecos_simple <- meow_ecos %>%
  dplyr::select(ECOREGION, geometry)

meow_ecos_stats <- meow_ecos_simple %>%
  left_join(ecoregion_stats, by = "ECOREGION")

cat("Ecoregions with data:", sum(!is.na(meow_ecos_stats$mean_FEI)), "\n")

# Get world map
land <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# --- Clip MEOW ecoregions to remove high seas ---
cat("Clipping ecoregions to continental waters...\n")

sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# Fix geometries with buffer(0) trick
meow_ecos_fixed <- meow_ecos %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_buffer(0)

High_seas_proj <- st_transform(High_seas, st_crs(meow_ecos_fixed))
High_seas_fixed <- High_seas_proj %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_buffer(0)

High_seas_union <- st_union(High_seas_fixed)

# Remove high seas from ecoregion polygons
meow_ecos_clipped <- st_difference(meow_ecos_fixed, High_seas_union)

sf_use_s2(TRUE)

cat("Clipped ecoregions created.\n")

# --- Join stats to clipped ecoregions ---
meow_ecos_clipped_simple <- meow_ecos_clipped %>%
  dplyr::select(ECOREGION, geometry)

meow_ecos_stats <- meow_ecos_clipped_simple %>%
  left_join(ecoregion_stats, by = "ECOREGION")
#======================
# 4. ECOREGION CHOROPLETH MAPS
#======================

cat("Creating ecoregion maps...\n")

# Map theme
eco_map_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0)
  )

# Map A: Mean FEI by ecoregion
map_eco_fei <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = meow_ecos_stats, aes(fill = mean_FEI), color = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = "darkgrey", color = "darkgrey", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "inferno",
    name = "Mean FEI",
    na.value = "grey90",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 15, barheight = 0.5,
                           title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "(A) Mean FEI by ecoregion", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  eco_map_theme

# Map B: Mean SFEI by ecoregion
map_eco_sfei <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = meow_ecos_stats, aes(fill = mean_SFEI), color = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = "darkgrey", color = "darkgrey", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    name = "Mean SFEI",
    na.value = "grey90",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 15, barheight = 0.5,
                           title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "(B) Mean SFEI by ecoregion", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  eco_map_theme

# Map C: Mean richness of highly overexposed species
map_eco_overexposed <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = meow_ecos_stats, aes(fill = mean_richness_overexposed), color = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = "darkgrey", color = "darkgrey", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "rocket",
    direction = -1,
    name = "Mean richness",
    na.value = "grey90",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 15, barheight = 0.5,
                           title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "(C) Mean richness of highly overexposed species by ecoregion", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  eco_map_theme

# Map D: Mean richness of high-conflict species
map_eco_conflict <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = meow_ecos_stats, aes(fill = mean_richness_conflict), color = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = "darkgrey", color = "darkgrey", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#FEE5D9", "#FCAE91", "#FB6A4A", "#DE2D26", "#A50F15"),
    name = "Mean richness",
    na.value = "grey90",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 15, barheight = 0.5,
                           title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "(D) Mean richness of high-conflict species by ecoregion", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  eco_map_theme

# Combine maps
combined_eco_maps <- (map_eco_fei | map_eco_sfei) / 
                     (map_eco_overexposed | map_eco_conflict)

print(combined_eco_maps)

ggsave(
  here::here("R", "Outputs", "Fig_FEI_SFEI_ecoregion_maps.png"),
  combined_eco_maps,
  width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

# 5. TOP 20 ECOREGION BARPLOTS
#======================

  arrange(mean_SFEI) %>%
  head(20)

bar_bottom_sfei <- ggplot(bottom20_sfei, aes(x = reorder(ECOREGION, mean_SFEI), y = mean_SFEI)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "coral") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "(B) Bottom 20 ecoregions by mean SFEI", x = NULL, y = "Mean SFEI") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))

# Bottom 20 by richness of highly overexposed species
bottom20_overexposed <- ecoregion_stats %>%
  arrange(mean_richness_overexposed) %>%
  head(20)

bar_bottom_overexposed <- ggplot(bottom20_overexposed, 
                                  aes(x = reorder(ECOREGION, mean_richness_overexposed), 
                                      y = mean_richness_overexposed)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "coral") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "(C) Bottom 20 ecoregions by highly overexposed species richness", 
       x = NULL, y = "Mean richness") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))

# Bottom 20 by richness of high-conflict species
bottom20_conflict <- ecoregion_stats %>%
  arrange(mean_richness_conflict) %>%
  head(20)

bar_bottom_conflict <- ggplot(bottom20_conflict, 
                               aes(x = reorder(ECOREGION, mean_richness_conflict), 
                                   y = mean_richness_conflict)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "coral") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "(D) Bottom 20 ecoregions by high-conflict species richness", 
       x = NULL, y = "Mean richness") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))

# Combine bottom 20 barplots
combined_bottom20 <- (bar_bottom_fei | bar_bottom_sfei) / 
                     (bar_bottom_overexposed | bar_bottom_conflict)

print(combined_bottom20)

ggsave(
  here::here("R", "Outputs", "Fig_bottom20_ecoregions_FEI_SFEI.png"),
  combined_bottom20,
  width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

#======================
# 7. SAVE ECOREGION STATISTICS
#======================

cat("\n=== TOP 10 ECOREGIONS BY METRIC ===\n")

cat("\nTop 10 by Mean FEI:\n")
print(head(ecoregion_stats %>% arrange(desc(mean_FEI)) %>% 
             select(ECOREGION, REALM, mean_FEI, sd_FEI), 10))

cat("\nTop 10 by Mean SFEI:\n")
print(head(ecoregion_stats %>% arrange(desc(mean_SFEI)) %>% 
             select(ECOREGION, REALM, mean_SFEI, sd_SFEI), 10))

cat("\nTop 10 by Highly Overexposed Richness:\n")
print(head(ecoregion_stats %>% arrange(desc(mean_richness_overexposed)) %>% 
             select(ECOREGION, REALM, mean_richness_overexposed), 10))

cat("\nTop 10 by High-Conflict Richness:\n")
print(head(ecoregion_stats %>% arrange(desc(mean_richness_conflict)) %>% 
             select(ECOREGION, REALM, mean_richness_conflict), 10))

# Save statistics
write_csv(ecoregion_stats, here::here("R", "Outputs", "Ecoregion_FEI_SFEI_stats.csv"))

cat("\nEcoregion statistics saved.\n")
```

## Barplots of FEI and SFEI 
```{r}
#| label: fei-sfei-species-histograms
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 6

#======================
# SPECIES-LEVEL FEI AND SFEI BAR PLOTS
#======================

# Prepare data
plot_data <- SFEI_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(SFEI), !is.na(IUCN), !is.na(FEI_observed))

# Define IUCN labels and colors
iucn_labels <- c("1" = "LC", "2" = "NT", "3" = "VU", "4" = "EN", "5" = "CR")
iucn_colors <- c(
  "LC" = "#38AB38",
  "NT" = "#58AFFF", 
  "VU" = "#FEC748",
  "EN" = "#FC7F3F",
  "CR" = "#D81E05"
)

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(IUCN_label = factor(iucn_labels[as.character(IUCN)], 
                              levels = c("LC", "NT", "VU", "EN", "CR")))

# --- 1. FEI bar plot (species ordered by increasing FEI) ---
fei_bar_data <- plot_data %>%
  arrange(FEI_observed) %>%
  mutate(species_order = row_number())

fei_barplot <- ggplot(fei_bar_data, aes(x = species_order, y = FEI_observed, fill = IUCN_label)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = iucn_colors, name = "IUCN Status") +
  labs(
    title = "Fishing Exposure Index (FEI)",
    x = "Species",
    y = "FEI (log fishing hours)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# --- 1. FEI bar plot (species ordered by increasing FEI) ---
fei_bar_data <- plot_data %>%
  arrange(FEI_observed) %>%
  mutate(species_order = row_number())

# Get x-axis range for rectangles
n_species <- nrow(fei_bar_data)

# Calculate n and % per FEI category
n_low <- sum(fei_bar_data$FEI_observed <= 4)
n_moderate <- sum(fei_bar_data$FEI_observed > 4 & fei_bar_data$FEI_observed <= 5.5)
n_high <- sum(fei_bar_data$FEI_observed > 5.5 & fei_bar_data$FEI_observed <= 7)
n_veryhigh <- sum(fei_bar_data$FEI_observed > 7)

pct_low <- round(100 * n_low / n_species, 1)
pct_moderate <- round(100 * n_moderate / n_species, 1)
pct_high <- round(100 * n_high / n_species, 1)
pct_veryhigh <- round(100 * n_veryhigh / n_species, 1)

fei_barplot <- ggplot(fei_bar_data, aes(x = species_order, y = FEI_observed, fill = IUCN_label)) +
  # Background panels for FEI categories
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species + 0.5, ymin = 0, ymax = 4, 
           fill = "#77dd77", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species + 0.5, ymin = 4, ymax = 5.5, 
           fill = "#fdfd96", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species + 0.5, ymin = 5.5, ymax = 7, 
           fill = "#ffb347", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species + 0.5, ymin = 7, ymax = 12, 
           fill = "#ff6961", alpha = 0.5) +
  # Bars
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = iucn_colors, name = "IUCN Status") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Fishing Exposure Index (FEI)",
    x = "Species",
    y = "FEI (log fishing hours)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  # Category labels with n and %
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = 2, 
           label = paste0("Low (n=", n_low, ", ", pct_low, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20") +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = 4.75, 
           label = paste0("Moderate (n=", n_moderate, ", ", pct_moderate, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20") +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = 6.25, 
           label = paste0("High (n=", n_high, ", ", pct_high, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20") +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = 9, 
           label = paste0("Very high (n=", n_veryhigh, ", ", pct_veryhigh, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20")

# --- 2. SFEI bar plot (species ordered by increasing SFEI) ---
sfei_bar_data <- plot_data %>%
  arrange(SFEI) %>%
  mutate(species_order = row_number())

# Get range
n_species_sfei <- nrow(sfei_bar_data)
max_sfei <- max(sfei_bar_data$SFEI, na.rm = TRUE)
min_sfei <- min(sfei_bar_data$SFEI, na.rm = TRUE)

# Calculate n and % per SFEI category
n_underexposed <- sum(sfei_bar_data$SFEI <= 0)
n_moderate_over <- sum(sfei_bar_data$SFEI > 0 & sfei_bar_data$SFEI <= 1.96)
n_highly_over <- sum(sfei_bar_data$SFEI > 1.96)

pct_underexposed <- round(100 * n_underexposed / n_species_sfei, 1)
pct_moderate_over <- round(100 * n_moderate_over / n_species_sfei, 1)
pct_highly_over <- round(100 * n_highly_over / n_species_sfei, 1)

sfei_barplot <- ggplot(sfei_bar_data, aes(x = species_order, y = SFEI, fill = IUCN_label)) +
  # Background panels for SFEI categories
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species_sfei + 0.5, ymin = min_sfei - 1, ymax = 0, 
           fill = "#77dd77", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species_sfei + 0.5, ymin = 0, ymax = 1.96, 
           fill = "#fdfd96", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = n_species_sfei + 0.5, ymin = 1.96, ymax = max_sfei + 5, 
           fill = "#ff6961", alpha = 0.5) +
  # Reference lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.96, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  # Bars
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = iucn_colors, name = "IUCN Status") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Standardized Fishing Exposure Index (SFEI)",
    x = "Species",
    y = "SFEI (Z-score)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  # Category labels with n and %
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = min_sfei / 2, 
           label = paste0("Underexposed (n=", n_underexposed, ", ", pct_underexposed, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20") +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = 6, 
           label = paste0("Moderately overexposed (n=", n_moderate_over, ", ", pct_moderate_over, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20") +
  annotate("text", x = 15, y = max_sfei * 0.7, 
           label = paste0("Highly overexposed (n=", n_highly_over, ", ", pct_highly_over, "%)"), 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey20")

# --- 3. Combine plots ---
combined_barplots <- ggpubr::ggarrange(
  fei_barplot, sfei_barplot,
  ncol = 2, nrow = 1,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "bottom",
  labels = c("(A)", "(B)"),
  font.label = list(size = 14, face = "bold")
)

print(combined_barplots)

ggsave(
  here::here("R", "Outputs", "Fig_FEI_SFEI_species_barplots.png"),
  combined_barplots,
  width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

cat("Species barplots saved.\n")
```

## FEI and SFEI accross IUCN status
```{r}
#| label: fei-sfei-iucn-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 6

#======================
# FISHING EXPOSURE VS IUCN THREAT STATUS ANALYSIS
#======================

library(DescTools)
library(moments)
library(quantreg)

# Prepare data
fei_iucn_data <- SFEI_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(SFEI), !is.na(IUCN), !is.na(FEI_observed)) %>%
  mutate(
    IUCN_status = case_when(
      IUCN == 1 ~ "LC",
      IUCN == 2 ~ "NT",
      IUCN == 3 ~ "VU",
      IUCN == 4 ~ "EN",
      IUCN == 5 ~ "CR",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(IUCN_status != "Unknown")

# Define IUCN colors and order
iucn_colors <- c(
  "LC" = "#38AB38",
  "NT" = "#58AFFF",
  "VU" = "#FEC748",
  "EN" = "#FC7F3F",
  "CR" = "#D81E05"
)
iucn_order <- c("LC", "NT", "VU", "EN", "CR")

#======================
# 1. SUMMARY STATISTICS
#======================

cat("=== FEI SUMMARY STATISTICS BY IUCN STATUS ===\n\n")

fei_summary <- fei_iucn_data %>%
  group_by(IUCN_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_FEI = mean(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_FEI = median(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_FEI = sd(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_FEI = min(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_FEI = max(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(IUCN_status, levels = iucn_order))

print(fei_summary)

cat("\n=== SFEI SUMMARY STATISTICS BY IUCN STATUS ===\n\n")

sfei_summary <- fei_iucn_data %>%
  group_by(IUCN_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_SFEI = mean(SFEI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_SFEI = median(SFEI, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_SFEI = sd(SFEI, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_highly_overexposed = round(100 * sum(SFEI > 1.96) / n(), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(IUCN_status, levels = iucn_order))

print(sfei_summary)

# Skewness
cat("\n=== DISTRIBUTION SHAPE (Skewness) ===\n")

skewness_fei <- fei_iucn_data %>%
  group_by(IUCN_status) %>%
  summarise(
    skewness_FEI = skewness(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    skewness_SFEI = skewness(SFEI, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(IUCN_status, levels = iucn_order))

print(skewness_fei)

#======================
# 2. NON-PARAMETRIC STATISTICAL TESTS
#======================

cat("\n=== NON-PARAMETRIC STATISTICAL TESTS ===\n")

# --- FEI Tests ---
cat("\n--- FEI TESTS ---\n")

# Jonckheere-Terpstra test (for increasing trend: do more threatened species have higher FEI?)
cat("\n1. JONCKHEERE-TERPSTRA TEST (FEI ~ IUCN, increasing):\n")
jt_fei <- JonckheereTerpstraTest(fei_iucn_data$FEI_observed,
                                  fei_iucn_data$IUCN,
                                  alternative = "increasing")
print(jt_fei)

# Spearman correlation
cat("\n2. SPEARMAN RANK CORRELATION (FEI ~ IUCN):\n")
spearman_fei <- cor.test(fei_iucn_data$IUCN,
                          fei_iucn_data$FEI_observed,
                          method = "spearman")
print(spearman_fei)

# KS test (LC vs CR)
cat("\n3. KOLMOGOROV-SMIRNOV TEST (FEI: LC vs CR):\n")
ks_fei <- ks.test(
  fei_iucn_data$FEI_observed[fei_iucn_data$IUCN_status == "LC"],
  fei_iucn_data$FEI_observed[fei_iucn_data$IUCN_status == "CR"]
)
print(ks_fei)

# --- SFEI Tests ---
cat("\n--- SFEI TESTS ---\n")

# Jonckheere-Terpstra test
cat("\n1. JONCKHEERE-TERPSTRA TEST (SFEI ~ IUCN, increasing):\n")
jt_sfei <- JonckheereTerpstraTest(fei_iucn_data$SFEI,
                                   fei_iucn_data$IUCN,
                                   alternative = "increasing")
print(jt_sfei)

# Spearman correlation
cat("\n2. SPEARMAN RANK CORRELATION (SFEI ~ IUCN):\n")
spearman_sfei <- cor.test(fei_iucn_data$IUCN,
                           fei_iucn_data$SFEI,
                           method = "spearman")
print(spearman_sfei)

# KS test (LC vs CR)
cat("\n3. KOLMOGOROV-SMIRNOV TEST (SFEI: LC vs CR):\n")
ks_sfei <- ks.test(
  fei_iucn_data$SFEI[fei_iucn_data$IUCN_status == "LC"],
  fei_iucn_data$SFEI[fei_iucn_data$IUCN_status == "CR"]
)
print(ks_sfei)

#======================
# 3. QUANTILE REGRESSION
#======================

cat("\n=== QUANTILE REGRESSION ANALYSIS ===\n")

quantiles <- seq(0.3, 0.9, by = 0.1)

# --- FEI Quantile Regression ---
qr_fei_results <- data.frame()

for (tau in quantiles) {
  tryCatch({
    qr_model <- rq(FEI_observed ~ IUCN, tau = tau, data = fei_iucn_data)
    qr_summary <- summary(qr_model, se = "boot", R = 500)
    coef_table <- qr_summary$coefficients
    
    temp_result <- data.frame(
      Quantile = paste0("Q", tau * 100),
      Tau = tau,
      Slope = coef_table[2, 1],
      SE = coef_table[2, 2],
      t_value = coef_table[2, 3],
      p_value = coef_table[2, 4]
    )
    
    qr_fei_results <- rbind(qr_fei_results, temp_result)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(paste("Error at tau =", tau, ":", e$message, "\n"))
  })
}

qr_fei_results$Significant <- ifelse(qr_fei_results$p_value < 0.05, "Yes*", "No")

cat("\nFEI Quantile Regression Results:\n")
print(qr_fei_results)

# --- SFEI Quantile Regression ---
qr_sfei_results <- data.frame()

for (tau in quantiles) {
  tryCatch({
    qr_model <- rq(SFEI ~ IUCN, tau = tau, data = fei_iucn_data)
    qr_summary <- summary(qr_model, se = "boot", R = 500)
    coef_table <- qr_summary$coefficients
    
    temp_result <- data.frame(
      Quantile = paste0("Q", tau * 100),
      Tau = tau,
      Slope = coef_table[2, 1],
      SE = coef_table[2, 2],
      t_value = coef_table[2, 3],
      p_value = coef_table[2, 4]
    )
    
    qr_sfei_results <- rbind(qr_sfei_results, temp_result)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(paste("Error at tau =", tau, ":", e$message, "\n"))
  })
}

qr_sfei_results$Significant <- ifelse(qr_sfei_results$p_value < 0.05, "Yes*", "No")

cat("\nSFEI Quantile Regression Results:\n")
print(qr_sfei_results)

#======================
# 4. VISUALIZATIONS
#======================

# Calculate sample sizes for labels
n_per_category <- fei_iucn_data %>%
  group_by(IUCN_status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(factor(IUCN_status, levels = iucn_order))

x_labels <- paste0(iucn_order, "\n(n=", n_per_category$n, ")")

# --- Panel A: FEI by IUCN ---
panel_fei <- ggplot(fei_iucn_data,
                     aes(x = factor(IUCN_status, levels = iucn_order),
                         y = FEI_observed)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = IUCN_status),
              width = 0.15,
              size = 1.5,
              alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "point",
               size = 3,
               color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = function(x) {
    mean_val <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    se_val <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x)))
    return(data.frame(y = mean_val,
                      ymin = mean_val - se_val,
                      ymax = mean_val + se_val))
  },
  geom = "errorbar",
  width = 0.15,
  color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = iucn_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
  labs(
    x = "IUCN Red List threat status",
    y = "FEI (log fishing hours)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

# --- Panel B: SFEI by IUCN ---
panel_sfei <- ggplot(fei_iucn_data,
                      aes(x = factor(IUCN, levels = iucn_order),
                          y = SFEI)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.96, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = IUCN),
              width = 0.15,
              size = 1.5,
              alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "point",
               size = 3,
               color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = function(x) {
    mean_val <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    se_val <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x)))
    return(data.frame(y = mean_val,
                      ymin = mean_val - se_val,
                      ymax = mean_val + se_val))
  },
  geom = "errorbar",
  width = 0.15,
  color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = iucn_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
  annotate("text", x = 5.4, y = 1.96, label = "p = 0.05", 
           color = "red", size = 3, hjust = 0) +
  labs(
    x = "IUCN Red List threat status",
    y = "SFEI (Z-score)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

# Combine panels
fig_fei_sfei_iucn <- ggarrange(
  panel_fei, panel_sfei,
  ncol = 2, nrow = 1,
  labels = c("(A)", "(B)"),
  font.label = list(size = 14, face = "bold")
)

print(fig_fei_sfei_iucn)

ggsave(
  here::here("R", "Outputs", "Fig_FEI_SFEI_by_IUCN.png"),
  fig_fei_sfei_iucn,
  width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

#======================
# 5. SUMMARY TABLE FOR MANUSCRIPT
#======================

cat("\n=== SUMMARY FOR MANUSCRIPT ===\n\n")

# Create combined summary table
summary_table <- fei_iucn_data %>%
  group_by(IUCN_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    FEI_mean = round(mean(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    FEI_se = round(sd(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), 2),
    SFEI_mean = round(mean(SFEI, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SFEI_se = round(sd(SFEI, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), 2),
    pct_overexposed = round(100 * sum(SFEI > 1.96) / n(), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(IUCN_status, levels = iucn_order))

kable(summary_table,
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("IUCN", "n", "FEI mean", "FEI SE", 
                    "SFEI mean", "SFEI SE", "% Highly overexposed"),
      caption = "Fishing exposure metrics by IUCN threat status") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)

# Save summary
write_csv(summary_table, here::here("R", "Outputs", "FEI_SFEI_by_IUCN_summary.csv"))

cat("\nAnalysis complete.\n")
```

## Trait sensibility 

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Calcul de l'indice de Sensibilité (S) et Vulnérabilité (V) à la pêche
# =============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Charger les données
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Traits
traits <- read_excel(here("R", "Data", "Trait_data_final.xlsx"))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Calculer les terciles de max.length
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Convertir en numérique (les "NA" texte deviennent NA)
traits <- traits %>%
  mutate(max.length = as.numeric(max.length))

# Vérifier
summary(traits$max.length)

# Maintenant calculer les terciles
length_terciles <- quantile(traits$max.length, probs = c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)
length_terciles
length_terciles <- quantile(traits$max.length, probs = c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Terciles de max.length:\n")
cat("  T1 (33%):", length_terciles[1], "cm\n")
cat("  T2 (67%):", length_terciles[2], "cm\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Calculer l'indice de Sensibilité (S)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

traits_sensitivity <- traits %>%
  mutate(
    # Score max.length (terciles)
    score_length = case_when(
      max.length <= length_terciles[1] ~ 0,
      max.length <= length_terciles[2] ~ 1,
      max.length > length_terciles[2] ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Score reproduction
    score_repro = case_when(
      reproduction == "oviparous" ~ 0,
      reproduction == "ovoviviparous" ~ 1,
      reproduction == "viviparous" ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Score deepwater
    score_deep = case_when(
      deepwater == "no" ~ 0,
      deepwater == "yes" ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Score habitat
    score_habitat = case_when(
      habitat == "shelf" ~ 2,
      habitat %in% c("shelf/slope", "slope", "all") ~ 1,
      habitat %in% c("slope/offshore", "offshore") ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Score vertical
    score_vertical = case_when(
      vertical == "benthic" ~ 0,
      vertical == "benthopelagic" ~ 1,
      vertical == "pelagic" ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Sensibilité totale (normalisée 0-1)
    S = (score_length + score_repro + score_deep + score_habitat + score_vertical) / 10
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Résumé de la sensibilité
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== Résumé de l'indice de Sensibilité (S) ===\n")
print(summary(traits_sensitivity$S))

cat("\nNombre d'espèces avec S calculé:", sum(!is.na(traits_sensitivity$S)), "\n")
cat("Nombre d'espèces avec NA:", sum(is.na(traits_sensitivity$S)), "\n")

# Distribution des scores individuels
cat("\n=== Distribution des scores par trait ===\n")
traits_sensitivity %>%
  summarise(
    across(starts_with("score_"), 
           list(mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE), 
                na = ~sum(is.na(.))),
           .names = "{.col}_{.fn}")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  print(n = 20)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Fusionner avec FEI/SFEI et calculer la Vulnérabilité (V)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Normaliser FEI entre 0 et 1 pour le calcul de P (exposition)
# Recalculer species_vulnerability avec le filtre de coverage
species_vulnerability <- traits_sensitivity %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, Family, Order, Superorder, 
                max.length, reproduction, deepwater, habitat, vertical,
                score_length, score_repro, score_deep, score_habitat, score_vertical, S) %>%
  left_join(
    SFEI_results %>% 
      filter(Fishing_Data_Coverage > 0.5) %>%  # Appliquer le même filtre que dans le manuscrit
      dplyr::select(Species, FEI_observed, SFEI, p_value, IUCN, FUSE, EDGE2),
    by = "Species"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(FEI_observed) & !is.na(S)) %>%
  mutate(
    P = (FEI_observed - min(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
        (max(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE) - min(FEI_observed, na.rm = TRUE)),
    V = S * P
  )

nrow(species_vulnerability)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Résumé
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("=== Résumé de la Sensibilité (S) ===\n")
print(summary(species_vulnerability$S))

cat("\n=== Résumé de l'Exposition (P) ===\n")
print(summary(species_vulnerability$P))

cat("\n=== Résumé de la Vulnérabilité (V) ===\n")
print(summary(species_vulnerability$V))

cat("\nNombre d'espèces avec V calculé:", nrow(species_vulnerability), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Top 20 espèces les plus vulnérables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

top20_vulnerable <- species_vulnerability %>%
  arrange(desc(V)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, IUCN, S, P, V, FEI_observed, SFEI) %>%
  head(20)

cat("\n=== Top 20 espèces les plus vulnérables à la pêche ===\n")
print(top20_vulnerable, n = 20)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Visualisation: S vs P (comme Fig. 2b,c dans Albouy et al.)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

p_vulnerability <- ggplot(species_vulnerability, aes(x = S, y = P)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = factor(IUCN), size = V), alpha = 0.6, width = 0.015, height = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("1" = "#4DAF4A", "2" = "#377EB8", "3" = "#FFFF33", 
               "4" = "#FF7F00", "5" = "#E41A1C"),
    labels = c("LC", "NT", "VU", "EN", "CR"),
    name = "IUCN Status"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 8), name = "Vulnerability (V)") +
  labs(
    x = "Intrinsic Sensitivity to Fishing (S)",
    y = "Fishing Exposure (P, normalized FEI)",
    title = "Vulnerability of elasmobranchs to fishing pressure"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_vulnerability)

ggsave(here("R", "Outputs", "Fig_vulnerability_S_vs_P.png"), 
       p_vulnerability, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Sauvegarder les résultats
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(species_vulnerability, here("R", "Outputs", "species_vulnerability.rds"))
write_csv(species_vulnerability, here("R", "Outputs", "species_vulnerability.csv"))

cat("\nFichiers sauvegardés dans R/Outputs/\n")

# =============================================================================
# Cartographie de la vulnérabilité (V) à la pêche
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Transformer species_presence_list en data.frame long
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

species_cell_long <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(species_presence_list), function(sp) {
    data.frame(
      Species = sp,
      PUID = species_presence_list[[sp]]
    )
  })
)

cat("Dimensions species_cell_long:", nrow(species_cell_long), "lignes\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Joindre avec la vulnérabilité et les coordonnées
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cell_vulnerability <- species_cell_long %>%
  # Joindre V par espèce
  left_join(
    species_vulnerability %>% dplyr::select(Species, S, P, V, IUCN),
    by = "Species"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(V)) %>%
  # Joindre coordonnées par cellule
  left_join(
    cell_metrics %>% dplyr::select(PUID, Longitude, Latitude),
    by = "PUID"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Longitude)) %>%
  # Agréger par cellule
  group_by(PUID, Longitude, Latitude) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_V = mean(V, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_S = mean(S, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_P = mean(P, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_species = n(),
    # Richesse d'espèces très vulnérables (V > 0.4)
    richness_high_V = sum(V > 0.4, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Richesse d'espèces vulnérables ET menacées (V > 0.3 & IUCN >= VU)
    richness_vulnerable_threatened = sum(V > 0.3 & IUCN >= 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n=== Résumé de la vulnérabilité par cellule ===\n")
print(summary(cell_vulnerability$mean_V))
cat("Nombre de cellules:", nrow(cell_vulnerability), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Cartographie
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

library(patchwork)

# Carte V moyenne
p_map_V <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = cell_vulnerability, 
            aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = mean_V)) +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey40", color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", name = "Mean V") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "(A) Mean Vulnerability to Fishing (V)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
  )

# Carte S moyenne
p_map_S <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = cell_vulnerability, 
            aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = mean_S)) +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey40", color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", name = "Mean S") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "(B) Mean Intrinsic Sensitivity (S)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
  )

# Carte richesse espèces très vulnérables
p_map_high_V <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = cell_vulnerability, 
            aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = richness_high_V)) +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey40", color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "rocket", name = "Species\nrichness") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "(C) Richness of highly vulnerable species (V > 0.4)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
  )

# Carte richesse espèces vulnérables ET menacées
p_map_vuln_threatened <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = cell_vulnerability, 
            aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = richness_vulnerable_threatened)) +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey40", color = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkred", name = "Species\nrichness") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "(D) Richness of vulnerable AND threatened species (V > 0.3 & IUCN ≥ VU)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
  )

# Combiner
p_combined <- (p_map_V | p_map_S) / (p_map_high_V | p_map_vuln_threatened)

print(p_combined)

ggsave(here("R", "Outputs", "Fig_vulnerability_maps.png"),
```
